mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mainboard ( user_id, title, content, file_path, reg_date, mod_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{filePath}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mainboard ORDER BY board_id DESC LIMIT #{skip}, #{amount}
SELECT * FROM main_comment WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY comment_id ASC
SELECT s.* FROM sub_comment s JOIN main_comment m ON s.comment_id = m.comment_id WHERE m.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY s.sub_id ASC
